forest_complement.statement: Let $X$ be a metric space. Let $a\in\mathbb N$, $q\in\mathbb R$, $K : X\to X\to\mathbb C$, $\sigma_1,\sigma_2 : X\to\mathbb Z$ and $F,G\subseteq X$, and assume an instance of the project structure `ProofData a q K σ₁ σ₂ F G` (docstring: data common through most of chapters 2-7). Through this instance $X$ carries a `DoublingMeasure` structure with constant $\mathrm{defaultA}(a)=2^a$, whose measure (`volume`) we denote by $\mu$, and a `CompatibleFunctions ℝ X (2^a)` structure, which provides a type $\Theta(X)$ of continuous real-valued functions on $X$; let $Q : X\to\Theta(X)$ be the simple function given by the field `Q` of the `ProofData` instance. Let $\mathsf b\in\mathbb N$ be the project constant `𝕔` (per its docstring fixed equal to $100$), $D=\mathrm{defaultD}(a)=2^{\mathsf b a^2}$, $\kappa=\mathrm{default}\kappa(a)=2^{-10a}$, $S=\mathrm{defaultS}(X)\in\mathbb N$ (the natural number `defaultS` determined by the `ProofData`), and $o=\mathrm{cancelPt}(X)\in X$ (the point `cancelPt X`, chosen so that every function in $\Theta(X)$ vanishes at it). Assume a tile structure `TileStructure Q D κ S o` on $X$, and let $\mathfrak P(X)$ be its (finite) type of tiles, partially ordered by the project order `instPartialOrder𝔓Real`. Let $G'\subseteq X$ be the project set `G'` (docstring: the set $G'$ defined below (5.1.28)), defined as $G_1\cup G_2\cup G_3$ for the project sets `G₁`, `G₂`, `G₃`. Let $\mathfrak P_1\subseteq\mathfrak P(X)$ be the project set `𝔓₁` (docstring: the set $\mathfrak P_1$ defined in (5.1.30)), defined as $\bigcup_{n\in\mathbb N}\bigcup_{k\le n}\bigcup_{j\le 2n+3}\mathfrak C_5(k,n,j)$, where $\mathfrak C_5(k,n,j)$ is the project set `ℭ₅ k n j`, and write $\mathfrak P_1^c$ for its complement in $\mathfrak P(X)$. For a set of tiles $\mathfrak C\subseteq\mathfrak P(X)$, a function $g : X\to\mathbb C$ and $x\in X$, let $\mathrm{carlesonSum}(\mathfrak C, g)(x)=\sum_{p\in\mathfrak C}\mathrm{carlesonOn}(p, g)(x)$, where $\mathrm{carlesonOn}(p,\cdot)$ is the project operator `carlesonOn` (docstring: the operator $T_p$ defined in Proposition 2.0.2). Let $\mathfrak P_{\mathrm{pos}}\subseteq\mathfrak P(X)$ be the project set `𝔓pos` (docstring: the set $\mathfrak P_{G\setminus G'}$ in the blueprint). All integrals below are lower Lebesgue integrals with respect to $\mu$ of extended nonnegative norms $\|\cdot\|_e\in[0,\infty]$, and all right-hand sides are computed in $[0,\infty]$. Let $\bar q\in\mathbb R_{\ge 0}$ denote $q$ regarded as a nonnegative real (the project value `nnq X`). Let $C_{5.1.3}(a,\bar q)\in\mathbb R_{\ge0}$ be the project constant `C5_1_3 a (nnq X)`, namely $2^{(\mathsf b+8+\lfloor \mathsf b/8\rfloor)a^3}/(\bar q-1)^5$ computed in $\mathbb R_{\ge 0}$ (with truncated subtraction). (Lemma 5.1.3.) Let $f : X\to\mathbb C$ be a measurable function with $\|f(x)\|\le\mathbf 1_F(x)$ for all $x\in X$. Then $$\int_{G\setminus G'}\big\|\mathrm{carlesonSum}(\mathfrak P_1^c, f)(x)\big\|_e\,d\mu(x)\le C_{5.1.3}(a,\bar q)\,\mu(G)^{1-q^{-1}}\,\mu(F)^{q^{-1}}.$$

Let $\mathsf b\in\mathbb N$ be the project constant `𝕔` (per its docstring fixed equal to $100$), $D=\mathrm{defaultD}(a)=2^{\mathsf b a^2}$, $\kappa=\mathrm{default}\kappa(a)=2^{-10a}$, $S=\mathrm{defaultS}(X)\in\mathbb N$ (the natural number `defaultS` determined by the `ProofData`), and $o=\mathrm{cancelPt}(X)\in X$ (the point `cancelPt X`, chosen so that every function in $\Theta(X)$ vanishes at it). Let $\mathfrak P_1\subseteq\mathfrak P(X)$ be the project set `𝔓₁` (docstring: the set $\mathfrak P_1$ defined in (5.1.30)), defined as $\bigcup_{n\in\mathbb N}\bigcup_{k\le n}\bigcup_{j\le 2n+3}\mathfrak C_5(k,n,j)$, where $\mathfrak C_5(k,n,j)$ is the project set `ℭ₅ k n j`, and write $\mathfrak P_1^c$ for its complement in $\mathfrak P(X)$. For a set of tiles $\mathfrak C\subseteq\mathfrak P(X)$, a function $g : X\to\mathbb C$ and $x\in X$, let $\mathrm{carlesonSum}(\mathfrak C, g)(x)=\sum_{p\in\mathfrak C}\mathrm{carlesonOn}(p, g)(x)$, where $\mathrm{carlesonOn}(p,\cdot)$ is the project operator `carlesonOn` (docstring: the operator $T_p$ defined in Proposition 2.0.2). Let $\mathfrak P_{\mathrm{pos}}\subseteq\mathfrak P(X)$ be the project set `𝔓pos` (docstring: the set $\mathfrak P_{G\setminus G'}$ in the blueprint). All integrals below are lower Lebesgue integrals with respect to $\mu$ of extended nonnegative norms $\|\cdot\|_e\in[0,\infty]$, and all right-hand sides are computed in $[0,\infty]$. Let $\bar q\in\mathbb R_{\ge 0}$ denote $q$ regarded as a nonnegative real (the project value `nnq X`). Let $N\in\mathbb N$ be the project number `maxℭ X`, defined (by choice) so that $n\le N$ whenever the project set $\mathfrak C(k,n)$ (`ℭ k n`) is nonempty for some $k$; let $Z=\mathrm{defaultZ}(a)=2^{12a}$. For $k,n,j,l\in\mathbb N$ let: $\mathfrak L_0'(k,n,l)$ be the $l$-th minimal layer of the project set $\mathfrak L_0(k,n)$ (`𝔏₀ k n`), i.e. the project set `𝔏₀' k n l`; $\mathfrak L_1(k,n,j,l)$ be the $l$-th minimal layer of the project set $\mathfrak C_1(k,n,j)$ (`ℭ₁ k n j`), i.e. `𝔏₁ k n j l`; $\mathfrak L_2(k,n,j)$ be the project set `𝔏₂ k n j` (docstring: the subset of $\mathfrak C_2(k,n,j)$ given in (5.1.15)); and $\mathfrak L_3(k,n,j,l)$ be the $l$-th maximal layer of the project set $\mathfrak C_3(k,n,j)$ (`ℭ₃ k n j`), i.e. `𝔏₃ k n j l`. Let $f : X\to\mathbb C$ be measurable, and for $\mathfrak A\subseteq\mathfrak P(X)$ write $I(\mathfrak A)=\int_{G\setminus G'}\|\mathrm{carlesonSum}(\mathfrak P_{\mathrm{pos}}\cap\mathfrak P_1^c\cap\mathfrak A, f)(x)\|_e\,d\mu(x)$. Then, with all summation indices ranging over natural numbers, $$\int_{G\setminus G'}\|\mathrm{carlesonSum}(\mathfrak P_1^c, f)(x)\|_e\,d\mu(x)\le \sum_{n\le N}\sum_{k\le n}\sum_{l<n} I(\mathfrak L_0'(k,n,l)) + \sum_{n\le N}\sum_{k\le n}\sum_{j\le 2n+3}\sum_{l\le Z(n+1)} I(\mathfrak L_1(k,n,j,l)) + \sum_{n\le N}\sum_{k\le n}\sum_{j\le 2n+3} I(\mathfrak L_2(k,n,j)) + \sum_{n\le N}\sum_{k\le n}\sum_{j\le 2n+3}\sum_{l\le Z(n+1)} I(\mathfrak L_3(k,n,j,l)).$$

Let $\bar q\in\mathbb R_{\ge 0}$ denote $q$ regarded as a nonnegative real (the project value `nnq X`). For $k,n\in\mathbb N$ let $\mathfrak C(k,n)\subseteq\mathfrak P(X)$ be the project set `ℭ k n` (docstring: the partition $\mathfrak C(k,n)$ of $\mathfrak P(k)$ by density, (5.1.7)), i.e. the set of tiles $p$ in the project set `TilesAt k` whose project density `dens' k {p}` lies in $(2^{4a-n}, 2^{4a-n+1}]$.
